karty.priklad: Mae gwaith yr arlunydd yn cael ei arddangos yn yr oriel.
karty.priklad_cs: The artist's work is being exhibited in the gallery.
karty.mnemo: ar + dangos (to show), as in arddangosfa (exhibition).

extra.pozn: arddangosfa = exhibition (L10); oriel = gallery (L5); own example

karty.priklad: Cafodd hi ei charcharu am werthu cyffuriau.
karty.priklad_cs: She was jailed for selling drugs (carcharu → [ch]archaru after ei = her; gwerthu → [w]erthu after am).
karty.mnemo: Latin carcer (prison), as in inCARCERate: locked in a cell.

extra.pozn: carchar = prison (L13); impersonal carcharwyd (p. 147); sentence based on the exercise on p. 147

karty.priklad: Gwelon nhw'r lleidr yn dianc mewn car mawr gwyrdd.
karty.priklad_cs: They saw the thief escaping in a big green car.
karty.mnemo: "DIE, ANKLE!" (DI-ANC): you twist your ankle jumping the prison wall, but you still escape.

extra.pozn: irregular stem: dihangodd e/hi = he/she escaped; dianc rhag = to escape from; sentence based on the exercise on p. 147

karty.priklad: Diflannodd y gath am dri diwrnod.
karty.priklad_cs: The cat disappeared for three days (tri → [d]ri after am).
karty.mnemo: The DIVER (DI-FLANN-u) dives and disappears.

extra.pozn: own example

karty.priklad: Gallwch chi hawlio'r arian yn ôl.
karty.priklad_cs: You can claim the money back.
karty.mnemo: hawl (a right) + -io: to claim what's yours by right.

extra.pozn: hawl = a right (hawliau dynol = human rights); own example

sever.priklad: Gallwch chi hawlio'r pres yn ôl.
sever.priklad_cs: You can claim the money back.

karty.priklad: Cafodd pump o bobl eu lladd mewn damwain ar yr M4.
karty.priklad_cs: Five people were killed in an accident on the M4 (pobl → [b]obl after o).
karty.mnemo: A LAD (LLADD) with a rolled-up newspaper – one swat and the wasp is killed.

extra.pozn: impersonal Lladdwyd pump o bobl (pp. 146–147); sentence based on the table on p. 146 and the exercise on p. 147

karty.priklad: Mae'r tân yn lledu'n gyflym.
karty.priklad_cs: The fire is spreading quickly (cyflym → [g]yflym after 'n).
karty.mnemo: lled = width: lledu = to widen, to spread.

extra.pozn: lled = width; llydan = wide (L15); own example

karty.priklad: Rhaid i ni leihau'r gwastraff.
karty.priklad_cs: We must reduce the waste (lleihau → [l]eihau after rhaid i ni).
karty.mnemo: llai (less) → lleihau = to make less.

extra.pozn: past tense lleihaodd; llai = less, lleiaf = least; gwastraff = waste (L2); own example

karty.priklad: Bydd y gwaith yn parhau tan y Nadolig.
karty.priklad_cs: The work will continue until Christmas.
karty.mnemo: para = to last + -hau: to keep going.

extra.pozn: past tense parhaodd; parhau i + verb = to carry on doing; para = to last (L6); own example

karty.priklad: Plannon ni ddwy goeden bob ochr i'r fynedfa.
karty.priklad_cs: We planted two trees either side of the entrance (dwy → [dd]wy as the object; coeden → [g]oeden after dwy; pob → [b]ob as an adverbial; mynedfa → [f]ynedfa after 'r, feminine).
karty.mnemo: From English plant.

extra.pozn: planhigyn = a plant; in the book, impersonal: lle plannwyd dwy goeden… (p. 149)

karty.priklad: Rhybuddiodd yr heddlu bobl i beidio â theithio.
karty.priklad_cs: The police warned people not to travel (pobl → [b]obl as the object; peidio → [b]eidio after i; teithio → [th]eithio after â).
karty.mnemo: rhybudd (warning) + -io.

extra.pozn: rhybudd = warning (L9); own example

karty.priklad: Cafodd y llew ei saethu.
karty.priklad_cs: The lion was shot.
karty.mnemo: saeth (arrow) → saethu.

extra.pozn: saeth = arrow; saethu ffilm = to shoot a film; impersonal Saethwyd y llew; sentence from the exercise on p. 148

karty.priklad: Wnei di dwymo'r cawl i fi?
karty.priklad_cs: Will you heat up the soup for me? (twymo → [d]wymo as the object after wnei di)
karty.mnemo: 'TWO MOre (TWY-MO) minutes in the microwave.' twym = warm.

extra.pozn: twym = warm (south); cynhesu (L2) = the same, usual in the north; own example

sever.priklad: Wnei di gynhesu'r cawl i mi?
sever.priklad_cs: Will you heat up the soup for me? (cynhesu → [g]ynhesu as the object after wnei di)
sever.pozn: north: cynhesu instead of twymo (outside the coursebook; cynhesu L2, twymo L12); i mi instead of i fi (outside the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Mae'r cwmni'n wynebu problemau mawr.
karty.priklad_cs: The company is facing big problems.
karty.mnemo: wyneb (face) → wynebu = to face up to something.

extra.pozn: own example

karty.priklad: Cafodd pob babi degan meddal bychan.
karty.priklad_cs: Every baby got a small soft toy (tegan → [d]egan as the object).
karty.mnemo: bach (small) → bychan: small and a bit literary.

extra.pozn: the book gives bach as a synonym; bychan sounds more literary or affectionate; the feminine form and the plural are outside the coursebook; sentence based on the papur bro, p. 149

karty.priklad: Bydd pawb yn cofio ei berfformiadau bywiog.
karty.priklad_cs: Everyone will remember his lively performances (perfformiadau → [b]erfformiadau after ei = his).
karty.mnemo: byw (to live, alive) + -iog.

extra.pozn: sentence based on the papur bro, p. 149 (written style; in speech with the echoing pronoun: ei berfformiadau bywiog e)

karty.priklad: Roedd y sgôr yn gyfartal ar hanner amser.
karty.priklad_cs: The score was level at half-time (cyfartal → [g]yfartal after yn).
karty.mnemo: The TALLY (cyf-AR-TAL) is equal: the score is level.

extra.pozn: gêm gyfartal = a draw (arall L12); own example

karty.priklad: Mae hi'n talu am bopeth yn electronig nawr.
karty.priklad_cs: She pays for everything electronically now (popeth → [b]opeth after am).
karty.mnemo: From English electronic.

extra.pozn: the ending -ig often makes adjectives, also in borrowed words (plastig); others: Cymreig, Gwyddelig, pwysig, siomedig, unig (note on p. 145); own example

sever.priklad: Mae hi'n talu am bopeth yn electronig rŵan.
sever.priklad_cs: She pays for everything electronically now (popeth → [b]opeth after am).

karty.priklad: Dw i'n teimlo'n euog.
karty.priklad_cs: I feel guilty.
karty.mnemo: The guilty one can't look you in the EYE (EU-og).

extra.pozn: euogrwydd = guilt; dieuog = innocent; own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r cwrs yn canolbwyntio ar yr iaith lafar.
karty.priklad_cs: The course concentrates on the spoken language (llafar → [l]afar after the feminine iaith).
karty.mnemo: Words pour out like LAVA (LLAF-ar) when you speak.

extra.pozn: iaith lafar = spoken language (table on p. 146); arholiad llafar = oral exam; Llwybrau Llafar = audio guide at St Fagans (p. 151); llefarydd = spokesperson (L11); own example
